headline: Dangote Refinery cuts diesel gantry price to N1,595 per litre
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery reduced its diesel gantry price by N125 per litre to N1,595 from N1,720 in its latest pricing adjustment.
why: Fuel price adjustments by large domestic refineries influence transportation costs, inflation metrics, and profit margins for downstream businesses.

impacts.name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery
impacts.why: Price cuts directly affect revenue per unit for the refining company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The refinery adjusted its pricing schedule downward for automotive gas oil.
